name: ai.mroffice/office
title: MR Office
description: Create, open and edit documents, spreadsheets and PDFs in MR Office's editor, inline in chat.

environmentVariables.name: MROFFICE_MCP_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.name: MROFFICE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the local editor pages (default 3410)
